row: Welcome to Midwest Family Wellness in wonderful Dardenne Prairie, MO. My name is Dr. Joshua Fink, and I am the Clinic Director. Our Dardenne Prairie chiropractors do our best to educate everyone about their spinal health and what they can do to stay active and healthy. Our objective is to have our patients live their lives the way they want to live without dealing with the pain or problems some people think are just part of life. Our mission since day 1 has been to adjust and educate.
